title: One-time Oracle database reset workflow for first production deploy

spec.problem: The imported Oracle production database holds incorrect data and has no Prisma history, so the first automated release is refused. The operator confirmed the data may be destroyed. SSH to the host is currently unreachable (OCI ingress allow-list), so the reset must run on the registered runner.

acceptance.text: The reset workflow has only a workflow_dispatch trigger, runs only on refs/heads/main, requires the exact confirmation input, shares the oracle-production concurrency group with releases, and only drops and recreates the nihongo_bjt database.
The reset workflow is exactly the reviewed manual, main-only, typed-confirmation, validated-backup, one-time (refuses once migration history exists) reset, pinned by test.
bootstrap-admin grants the wildcard permission to the super_admin role before creating the first actor, so a freshly provisioned operator can use every admin screen.

spec.expected_behavior: A manually dispatched, main-only workflow requiring an exact typed confirmation drops and recreates the nihongo_bjt database inside oci-postgres-1 on the production runner, nothing else.
spec.observed_behavior: Deploy Oracle production exits 3: content schema has tables but no _prisma_migrations.
spec.rollback_plan: Delete the reset workflow after use. Each reset keeps a validated pg_dump in data/backups/resets/ (restore with pg_restore into a recreated nihongo_bjt); the workflow refuses to run once migration history exists. Revert bootstrap-admin by redeploying the previous image.
